notes.title: Major Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Changes:
Bans gone. Now you can only pick cards.
Gravestones gone. No more needless stuff.
All earth cards nerfed. They were too strong.
All water cards buffed. They were too weak.
Some UI bugs fixed.

notes.title: Minor Update 2.11.2018
notes.content:
In this update:
[list]
[*] Standart language is now english.
[*] Added UI for spells cooldown.
[*] Fixed bug were card has identical cover.
[/list]

Also, soon there will be demo version which you can use to connect freely to your friend.
